project.name: SLM
project.objective: Build a personal-use research project for fine-tuning a Small Language Model on curated medical conversation data with a reproducible curation, training, evaluation, and remote GPU execution pipeline.

lifecycle.next_action: Write review queue + log checks, run gate

plan_approval.reason: Re-approved amended plan: task scopes now include data output dirs. No requirement or gate changes.

approval.reason: Reviewed SPEC.md in full; approved with Unsloth as v1 training framework (ADR-0013). Training on free-tier GPU backend (Colab first).

assumptions.text: A ~2K-example source conversation dataset with a usable research license can be obtained (Q1 decides).
Free-tier Colab GPU suffices for LoRA/QLoRA on a 1-3B model; fallback chain exists if not.

invariants.text: Source data in data/raw/ is write-once and never modified; a gate script re-hashes it.
Golden data is never used for training; lock hash verified by script at split and eval time.
The human is the final authority for curated data, golden lock, results, and model versions; no automated step may decide these.
No dataset download, training code, or GPU execution before spec and plan approval.

decisions.title: v1 single-stage SFT; action labels metadata-only
decisions.text: Train one LoRA/QLoRA SFT pass on curated atomic examples. Action labels used for review prioritization and eval slicing only. Two-stage/action-prefix training deferred to a T12 iteration if eval shows systematic action errors. See ADR-0003.

decisions.title: Golden isolation via locked store and grouped splitting
decisions.text: Golden lives in a separate locked store; splits allocate whole conversation groups with dedup before allocation; contamination checks gate T9 and T11. See ADR-0007.

decisions.title: Negatives excluded from SFT, reserved for preference data
decisions.text: Rejected examples kept with reason codes for eval slices, failure analysis, and future DPO pairs. Never mixed into ordinary SFT. See ADR-0008.

decisions.title: Job-spec contract for remote GPU execution
decisions.text: Repo stays source of truth; GPU backend executes a declarative approved job spec and returns artifacts. Manual Colab transfer in v1; automation later. See ADR-0010.

decisions.title: Unsloth as the v1 training framework
decisions.text: Human-decided 2026-09-30: v1 LoRA/QLoRA SFT executes via Unsloth on the free-tier GPU backend (Colab first), driven by the declarative job spec with pinned unsloth version. Vanilla TRL+PEFT is the fallback if the T10 base-model pick lacks Unsloth support. Recorded as ADR-0013; ML architecture and environment docs updated. FR-11 unchanged (framework-agnostic).

decisions.title: T5 v1 uses deterministic rules triage, LLM deferred
decisions.text: T5 triage v1 is a deterministic rulepack (model rules-triage/v1, rubric triage/v1), not an LLM call: the agent sandbox has no network access and gates require byte-identical re-runs, which an API model cannot promise. LLM triage is deferred to a T12 iteration if AC-T5-2 calibration shows rules failing. Rules lean safe (any dimension <=2 routes to REVIEW or REJECT); only T6 moves records into stores.

decisions.title: AC-T5-2 human calibration waived for T5-1 v1
decisions.text: Human (ARIF) waived the AC-T5-2 100-record human calibration for T5-1 v1 (2026-10-05): researcher bandwidth. Substitute evidence: agent smoke-graded 100 blind-ish records (47/100 agreement; rules err 45x toward REVIEW vs 5x toward leniency, i.e. safe direction) and audited every REJECT after precision tuning (837 -> 8 survivors, 8/8 correct). Report agreement is therefore labeled grader=agent, not human. Residual risk: semantic misses in ACCEPT that rules cannot see (1 observed: confident-wrong remote diagnosis); mitigation: T6 human review disposes all REVIEW plus an ACCEPT audit sample. The sample file keeps human_verdict fields, so a real human calibration can still run later.

knowledge.title: Sandboxed genesis CLI needs TEMP redirect
knowledge.text: The genesis CLI writes lockfiles to system Temp, which sandboxed shells cannot write. Set TEMP/TMP/TMPDIR to a writable dir before invoking genesis in this environment.

knowledge.title: iCliniq raw data provenance (T2 input)
knowledge.text: data/raw/iCliniq.json (7321 records) staged by human on 2026-09-30 from the ChatDoctor GitHub repo icliniq.json eval set (mirror of Kent0n-Li/ChatDoctor; also on HF as lavita/ChatDoctor-iCliniq). Repo LICENSE file is Apache-2.0 (code); README Limitations restricts data/model to academic research only, no commercial or clinical use. Compatible with this personal research project. Formal MANIFEST.json with hashes is T2 work.

knowledge.title: Opus raw data provenance (T2 input)
knowledge.text: data/raw/opusdiseaseconversations.jsonl (2197 records, 53277338 bytes, byte-identical to Hub copy) staged by human on 2026-09-30 from HF dataset nisten/opus-doctor-patient-conversations-all-human-diseases (Opus 4.8 synthetic doctor-patient conversations for all human diseases). License: MIT. Known data flaw per author: hallucinated PubMed IDs. Formal MANIFEST.json with hashes is T2 work.

knowledge.title: Task scopes must include data output dirs
knowledge.text: No-git fallback in inputManifest hashes the whole tree (hg repo: git ls-files unavailable), so task completion fails on derived data outside scope. Every implementation task scope must list its data output dirs (data/processed/, data/curated/, data/negative/, data/splits/, data/golden/, artifacts/, experiments/). Amended 2026-09-30 for T3-1..T11-1; T2-1/T12-1/T13-1 already correct.

knowledge.title: AC-T4-3 spot-check verdict (T4-1)
knowledge.text: Human (ARIF) reviewed data/processed/spotcheck_T4.md (50 records, seed 42) on 2026-10-05: extraction errors under 10 percent. AC-T4-3 passes.
